description: What Coucou's windows are allowed to do. Everything that touches the OS goes through Coucou's own commands, with one exception: the file picker behind the reply box's paperclip is tauri-plugin-dialog, because a native chooser is not worth hand-rolling twice. It can only open a picker — reading the chosen file still goes through Coucou's own ingest command. Granted by webview, never by window: the island's window also holds ChatGPT and the site, which are remote pages and get no IPC at all — a capability that names a window covers every webview inside it.
